description: Converts an existing Word, Excel, PowerPoint, OpenDocument, RTF or HTML document (up to 20 MB) to a PDF as it is, without filling in data, and returns the render with status and download_url. To make a document from a template and data, use render instead. Pass exactly one source: render_id, the render of a Word or PowerPoint template (output docx or pptx); path, a file on this machine; or file_base64 with file_name. Every call is a new render that counts units like a PDF; the Free plan cannot convert (Starter and above). The document is converted and not kept.

file_base64.description: The document to convert, base64 encoded; needs file_name

file_name.description: Name of the document, e.g. report.xlsx; the type is read from the content

filename.description: Name of the PDF behind download_url, e.g. report.pdf

landscape.description: Landscape for spreadsheets and documents without their own page setup

page_ranges.description: Pages to convert, e.g. 1-3,5; all pages when left out

path.description: Absolute path of the document on this machine

render_id.description: rnd_ id of a render whose output is docx or pptx, to get that document as a PDF

single_page_sheets.description: Each spreadsheet sheet on one page

name: convert_to_pdf
title: Convert an office document to PDF
